title: Best American Restaurant in Omaha, NE | Local Beer

facts.fact: The vendor's homepage states that it serves over 40 local beers on tap daily.
facts.quote: A BEAUTIFUL PATIO, DELICIOUS FOOD AND OVER 40 LOCAL BEERS ON TAP DAILY.

facts.fact: The vendor's homepage lists a happy hour specials time of 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM.
The vendor lists its location as 4909 S 135th St, Omaha, NE 68137.
A third-party Yelp reviewer says the vendor hosted a 90-guest event at its Millard location and praised the staff, which is a review claim rather than a vendor statement.
facts.quote: We hosted an event at Local in Millard and the whole staff was incredible! They kept coming around and were very attentive to our 90 guests!
